claims.claim: discoverglobalnetwork.com is the public marketing site for Discover Global Network and positions Diners Club International and PULSE as partner brands within one network.
claims.quote: Alongside our partners Diners Club International® and PULSE®, we power a global payment network that enables ever-expanding reach
claims.title: How We Partner | Discover Global Network
claims.publisher: Discover Global Network (DFS Services LLC, Capital One)
claims.label: Vendor
claims.note: Readable without account. Footer '© 2026 DFS Services LLC'.

claims.claim: The public 'Payments Providers: Get Started' page is the hub that routes acquirers and processors to the gated EASI Portal, BIN ranges, the Dev Center, Diners Club issuer resources and merchant referral.
claims.quote: Our Enablement, Acceptance Support Info-center, (EASI) Portal, provides the resources needed to enable transactions in-store, online and in-app.
claims.title: Get Started | Payments Providers | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Public page; links to https://www.discovereasi.com/easi/getregistration, /resources/payments-providers/bin-ranges/, https://developer.discover.com, https://discover.service-now.com/infonet, https://referamerchant.discoverglobalnetwork.com/.

claims.claim: The EASI Portal holds enablement materials, technical specifications, developer test card kits, product announcements and a Message Center to the network operations team, all behind registration.
claims.quote: Enablement materials and technical specifications Developer test card kits Product information and announcements Our Discover Global Network operations team via Message Center
claims.title: Get Started | Payments Providers | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Audience: acquirers, acquirer processors, issuers (per Service Center page).

claims.claim: discovereasi.com is a login-only portal with self-service registration ('Join Now') and a public Registration Quick Guide PDF; no content is readable without an account.
claims.quote: Secure Account Log In User ID Next Forgot User ID? Forgot Password? Not registered? Join Now Registration Quick Guide Need help?
claims.title: Discover EASI Portal Login | Discover Global Network
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Registration guide at https://www.discovereasi.com/easi/docs/EASI_Registration_Guide.pdf (not fetched, budget). Help contacts: Company EASI Portal Admin, Discover Account Executive, EASI@Discover.com.

claims.claim: The Discover Developer Center (developer.discover.com) requires an account for API access, and new users must go through a Discover representative via the Contact Us form.
claims.quote: How can I get access as a new user? Please fill out the Contact Us form, and a Discover representative will be in touch with you.
claims.title: FAQs | Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Login offers email/password and 'Use Discover User ID' (SAML SSO at /saml_login). Footer '© 2026 DFS Services LLC'.

claims.claim: Adding collaborators to a Developer Center app is invite-only through a Discover representative.
claims.quote: Currently, developer partners can only be added with an invite from a Discover® representative.
claims.title: FAQs | Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified

claims.claim: The Developer Center's public API catalogue is deliberately partial; the full product set is visible only after login and per-partner entitlement.
claims.quote: Not all of our products are currently published. While you may not see all of our products on the public pages, you will see the products you've been given access to once you've logged in.
claims.title: FAQs | Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Quote is 34 words in full; core sentence 'Not all of our products are currently published.' is the verbatim anchor.

claims.claim: The public Explore APIs page lists seven APIs without login: HCE Wallet Services, City Guides, Country Acceptance, Currency Converter, Tip Etiquette, ATM Locator and DCI Customer Service; Funds Transfer and Security are headings with no public entries.
claims.quote: Tokenize Discover® Cards to be stored within host card emulation based digital wallets for contactless and in-app transactions.
claims.title: Explore APIs | Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Each API has /api/<slug> and /api/<slug>/documentation links; documentation pages not fetched.

claims.claim: The Developer Center hands off to the Partner Product Portal, which it labels 'Enablement Resources'.
claims.quote: For more information on our API products, explore our Enablement Resources
claims.title: Discover Developer Center
claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Link target https://partner.discoverglobalnetwork.com.

claims.label: Verified
claims.note: Advanced Payments Portal: https://advancedpayments.discoverglobalnetwork.com/app/loginpage and /app/getregistration.

claims.claim: Merchants have a separate portal, Discover eCentral, and there is a distinct Discover Network Disputes Portal.

claims.claim: Fraud and risk products are enrolled through application PDFs or web forms from the Service Center: Account Incident Manager, Confirmed Fraud Portal, Fraud Alerts and High Brand Risk.
